candidate_reviews.quote: First, I’ll just start with a little bit of a production update.

candidate_reviews.quote: So, in Texas, 4680 cell production increased 80% Q2 over Q1, and the team surpassed 10 million production cells produced here in Texas.
candidate_reviews.rejection_reason: not attributable realized evidence (question, boilerplate, or generic context)

candidate_reviews.quote: Here in Texas, we’re preparing to launch our Cybertruck cell, which is 10% higher energy density than current production.
candidate_reviews.rejection_reason: not attributable realized evidence (question, boilerplate, or generic context)

candidate_reviews.quote: As we scale Cyber cell production through the end of the year and early next, we should be in a comfortable place on cost per cell.
candidate_reviews.rejection_reason: not attributable realized evidence (question, boilerplate, or generic context)

candidate_reviews.quote: We’re yet to integrate silicon or in-house cathode production, both reviewed on Battery Day, which do bring significant further energy density and cost improvements, but that is a topic for another day.
candidate_reviews.rejection_reason: not attributable realized evidence (question, boilerplate, or generic context)

candidate_reviews.quote: Lastly, it is important to remember that most of what we focused on a Battery Day was the Tesla-engineered 4680 production system and the improvements we strove to achieve on equipment, factory density, capital cost and utility cost reduction, all of which we are realizing in our Texas scale up to date.
candidate_reviews.rejection_reason: not attributable realized evidence (question, boilerplate, or generic context)

candidate_reviews.quote: And then secondly, as we continue to work on reducing our Austin and Berlin cost, which we did quite a bit of that from Q1 to Q2, these factories are still slightly above Model Y production costs elsewhere.
candidate_reviews.rejection_reason: not attributable realized evidence (question, boilerplate, or generic context)

candidate_reviews.quote: So -- and the production ramp will move as fast as the slowest and least likely elements of the entire supply chain and internal production.
candidate_reviews.rejection_reason: not attributable realized evidence (question, boilerplate, or generic context)

candidate_reviews.quote: We’re certainly better at production ramps that -- we’ve got a lot of experience with the production ramps.
candidate_reviews.rejection_reason: not attributable realized evidence (question, boilerplate, or generic context)

candidate_reviews.quote: But we are, in designing these actuators, designing them for volume production.
candidate_reviews.rejection_reason: not attributable realized evidence (question, boilerplate, or generic context)

candidate_reviews.quote: The first Optimus that is -- that will have all of the Tesla designed actuators, sort of production candidate actuators integrated and walking should be around November-ish.
candidate_reviews.rejection_reason: not attributable realized evidence (question, boilerplate, or generic context)

candidate_reviews.quote: The next question is, how has the order intake trended relatively to production levels during Q2?
candidate_reviews.rejection_reason: not attributable realized evidence (question, boilerplate, or generic context)

candidate_reviews.quote: I guess, demand has roughly tracked production.
candidate_reviews.rejection_reason: not attributable realized evidence (question, boilerplate, or generic context)

candidate_reviews.quote: So -- which is what we aim for is -- we look at -- it’s something that we have that really -- I think no other carmaker has -- is that we have real-time demand and real-time production, like so seven days a week.
candidate_reviews.rejection_reason: not attributable realized evidence (question, boilerplate, or generic context)

candidate_reviews.quote: Maybe you could put a finer point on the downtime impact that you spoke about in your prepared comments in terms of production impact and then also to what extent there’s a margin impact from those factory upgrades that you’re planning this quarter?
candidate_reviews.rejection_reason: not attributable realized evidence (question, boilerplate, or generic context)

candidate_reviews.quote: We think probably bring it into operation faster than anyone’s ever brought that much compute per unit time into production, since training is the fundamental limiting factor on progress with full self-driving and vehicle autonomy.
candidate_reviews.rejection_reason: not attributable realized evidence (question, boilerplate, or generic context)

candidate_reviews.quote: I do want to emphasize that there will be enormous challenges in reaching volume production with the Cybertruck, and then in making a Cybertruck cash flow positive.
candidate_reviews.rejection_reason: not attributable realized evidence (question, boilerplate, or generic context)

candidate_reviews.quote: So, I just want to emphasize that while I think this is potentially our best product ever and I think it is our best product ever, it is going to be -- require immense work to reach volume production and be cash flow positive at a price that people can afford.
candidate_reviews.rejection_reason: not attributable realized evidence (question, boilerplate, or generic context)

candidate_reviews.quote: That’s why I say prototypes are easy, production is hard.
candidate_reviews.rejection_reason: not attributable realized evidence (question, boilerplate, or generic context)

candidate_reviews.quote: But it’s difficult to going from a prototype to volume production, it’s like 10,000% harder to get to volume production than to make a prototype in the first place, and then it is even harder than that to reach positive cash flow.
candidate_reviews.rejection_reason: not attributable realized evidence (question, boilerplate, or generic context)

candidate_reviews.quote: In conclusion, we continue to focus on ramping production while maintaining positive cash flow and we continue to target -- expect to have around 1.8 million vehicle deliveries, as stated earlier this year.

candidate_reviews.rejection_reason: not attributable realized evidence (question, boilerplate, or generic context)

candidate_reviews.rejection_reason: not attributable realized evidence (question, boilerplate, or generic context)

candidate_reviews.quote: It’ll be by far the highest units per hour of any vehicle production ever.

candidate_reviews.quote: As Elon mentioned, Q2 was another record quarter of production and deliveries, as well as records in profit for our energy and services and other businesses.

candidate_reviews.quote: We’re yet to integrate silicon or in-house cathode production, both reviewed on Battery Day, which do bring significant further energy density and cost improvements, but that is a topic for another day.

candidate_reviews.quote: Lastly, it is important to remember that most of what we focused on a Battery Day was the Tesla-engineered 4680 production system and the improvements we strove to achieve on equipment, factory density, capital cost and utility cost reduction, all of which we are realizing in our Texas scale up to date.

candidate_reviews.quote: And then secondly, as we continue to work on reducing our Austin and Berlin cost, which we did quite a bit of that from Q1 to Q2, these factories are still slightly above Model Y production costs elsewhere.

candidate_reviews.quote: So -- and the production ramp will move as fast as the slowest and least likely elements of the entire supply chain and internal production.

candidate_reviews.quote: We’re certainly better at production ramps that -- we’ve got a lot of experience with the production ramps.

candidate_reviews.quote: But we are, in designing these actuators, designing them for volume production.

candidate_reviews.quote: So -- which is what we aim for is -- we look at -- it’s something that we have that really -- I think no other carmaker has -- is that we have real-time demand and real-time production, like so seven days a week.

candidate_reviews.quote: Maybe you could put a finer point on the downtime impact that you spoke about in your prepared comments in terms of production impact and then also to what extent there’s a margin impact from those factory upgrades that you’re planning this quarter?

candidate_reviews.quote: We think probably bring it into operation faster than anyone’s ever brought that much compute per unit time into production, since training is the fundamental limiting factor on progress with full self-driving and vehicle autonomy.

actuals.quote: Capital expenditures amounted to $11.34 billion in 2024 compared to $8.90 billion in 2023, representing an increase of $2.44 billion.

actuals.quote: Cash Flows from Investing Activities Net cash flows from investing activities and their variability across each period related primarily to capital expenditures, which were $11.34 billion and $8.90 billion for the years ended December 31, 2024 and 2023, respectively, mainly for AI-related capital expenditures, global factory expansion and machinery and equipment as we expand and enhance our product roadmap.
actuals.context: This increase was primarily due to favorable changes in net operating assets and liabilities of $2.29 billion, partially offset by a decrease in net income excluding non-cash expenses, gains and losses of $623 million. Cash Flows from Investing Activities Net cash flows from investing activities and their variability across each period related primarily to capital expenditures, which were $11.34 billion and $8.90 billion for the years ended December 31, 2024 and 2023, respectively, mainly for AI-related capital expenditures, global factory expansion and machinery and equipment as we expand and enhance our product roadmap.
